# Functions that write, or do not write, through an argument, for the `unmarked-mutation` rule.
mutable struct Box
    a::Int
    inner::Vector{Int}
end
direct(v) = (v[1] = 3; v)
aliased(v) = (w = v; push!(w, 1); w)
setprop(x) = (x.a = 1; x)
viafield(x) = (y = x.inner; push!(y, 1); x)
helper(x) = (x[1] = 1; nothing)
outer(x) = helper(x)
@noinline far_helper(x) = (x[1] = 1; nothing)
far_outer(x) = far_helper(x)
viaindex(x) = (x[1][1] = 1; nothing)
stashed(x) = (c = Box(0, x); setfield!(c, :inner, x); getfield(c, :inner)[1] = 1; c)

fresh_memory() = Core.memorynew(Memory{Int}, 1)
memwrite!(m) = Core.memoryrefset!(Core.memoryrefnew(m), 1, :not_atomic, true)
rebound(x) = (y = x; y = fresh_memory(); memwrite!(y); y)
fieldread(b) = getfield(b, :a)
viahelper(b) = fieldread(b)
fresh() = (v = Int[]; push!(v, 1); v)
readonly(b) = (t = similar(b); copyto!(t, b); t)
addup(a, b) = a + b
reads(v) = length(v)
bangwrite!(v) = (v[1] = 1; v)
@noinline countdown(v, n) = n == 0 ? length(v) : countdown(v, n - 1)

opaquecall(f, x) = f(x)
const SHARED = Int[]
opaqueglobal(f) = f(SHARED)
viaccall(x) = ccall(:jl_typeof_str, Cstring, (Any,), x)
